title: PairingOffer
description: One-time pairing offer created on the device; expires 10 minutes after creation.

device_id.description: Crockford base32 (no i, l, o, u) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(device_pub).

device_name.description: Optional display name shown on the Allow this bot? screen.

relay_pin.description: Optional base64url SHA-256 of the relay's DER certificate, for a self-signed relay.
